changeSet.sql: UPDATE permission SET active = false, deleted = true, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE subject IN ( 'ATTACH_ACT', 'ACTS', 'ATTACHED_CARDS', 'USER_INCOMINGS', 'CARD_FULL_INFO', 'FORM058_ATTACHED_CARDS', 'STAFF', 'EMPLOYEES', 'ORGANIZATIONS', 'ROLES', 'PERMISSIONS', 'MKB_LIST', 'COUNTRIES', 'STATES', 'CITIES', 'STREETS', 'RESIDENCES', 'NEIGHBORHOODS', 'CATALOGS', 'FORM_CATEGORIES', 'SICK_PATIENT_CATEGORIES', 'DISEASE_PLACES', 'POPULATION_TYPES', 'REFERENCE_COUNTRY_READ', 'REFERENCE_COUNTRY_MANAGE', 'REFERENCE_REGION_READ', 'REFERENCE_REGION_MANAGE', 'REFERENCE_DISTRICT_READ', 'REFERENCE_DISTRICT_MANAGE', 'REFERENCE_NEIGHBORHOOD_READ', 'REFERENCE_NEIGHBORHOOD_MANAGE', 'REPORTS', 'FORM1', 'FORM12', 'GRAPH1', 'MAP_GRAPHIC', 'ANALYTICAL_REPORT', 'FORM058_SENDER', 'FORM058_RECEIVER', 'FORM058_COMPLETE_BY_SUPERVISOR', 'FORM058_CHANGE_ORGANIZATION', 'RECEIVED' ) AND deleted_at IS NULL;

changeSet.author: uzinfocom
changeSet.sql: UPDATE action SET active = false, deleted = true, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code IN ('CARD_ATTACH', 'ORG_CHANGE', 'FORM_CANCEL', 'IMPORT') AND deleted_at IS NULL;
